versions.content: Provide Interrupt frame implementation source files If the BSW Module implements Interrupt frames , then the code file structure shall contain one or more files for their implementation: the Interrupt frame implementation source files. The file names shall be formed in the following way: <Mip>[_<Ie>]_Irq.c
